{{Quote|Happy Empire Day citizen! I have treats for all loyal citizens from our beloved Emperor.|Imperial Celebration Organizer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Gracious Government Mix''' was a type of [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]] [[Candy/Legends|candy]] largely sold by an [[Imperial Celebration Organizer]] during [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Favorites of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Gender/Legends|himself]], these chocolates were shaped to represent various symbols of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], fifteen in total, and fitted into a stylized box.

==Description==
Described as "delicious," the Gracious Government Mix was a type of cocoa [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]] [[Candy/Legends|candy]]. Prepared in boxes of fifteen, each chocolate came in various shapes and sizes, including four [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|helmets]], six [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], four [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crests]], and one large piece of chocolate resembling [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|mask]]. The box itself was colored black, and the lid was stylized with two blue and silver stripes, and a silver colored Imperial crest in the center. The interior consisted of a blue colored mold, in which the fifteen pieces of chocolate could snugly fit.<ref name="AED" />

==History==
Favorites of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Gender/Legends|himself]], the Gracious Government Mix was largely sold by an [[Imperial Celebration Organizer]] in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. In exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], the organizer would sell both these chocolates and bags of [[Order 66 Cookie]]s, but only to loyal Imperial citizens. Suspected sympathizers of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were turned away from publicly purchasing these confectioneries. Nevertheless, during the simultaneously held [[Remembrance Day]] festivities in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the Rebellion sold comparable goods, such as [[Favorites of the Force]] sour candy and [[Death Star Destruction]] energy drinks.<ref name="Empire Day">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ImperialCelebration2008.jpg|250px|thumb|An Imperial Celebration Officer stands among his fellow stormtroopers during the Empire Day festivities in Theed]]
[[W:c:swg:Gracious Government Mix|Gracious Government Mix]] first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The chocolates first made their debut as part of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 10.2|Chapter 10.2: ''The Search for the Meatlump King'']], on [[June 26]], [[2008]]. The release included the special [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] and Remembrance Day events in [[W:c:swg:Theed|Theed]] and [[W:c:swg:Coronet|Coronet]] respectively, to celebrate the fifth year anniversary of [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided|''Galaxies'']].<ref name="Chapter 10">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66960&resource=publish#ch102|text=Chapter 10.2: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref> The chocolates were reintroduced during the subsequent Empire Day festivities in [[2009]],<ref name="Empire Day 2009">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68349&month=062009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2009)}}</ref> [[2010]],<ref name="Empire Day 2010">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66962&resource=publish#gu170|text=Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and 2011.<ref name="Empire Day 2011">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref>

In exchange for [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credits]] and/or [[W:c:swg:Empire Day Tokens|Empire Day Tokens]] (depending on the item version), [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Imperial-aligned]] players could purchase two versions of the [[W:c:swg:Item|item]] during the Empire Day events.<ref name="AED" /> One version, requiring 2000 credits, was a consumable item which increased [[W:c:swg:Damage|damage]] and reduced [[W:c:swg:Action|action]] cost for a player's [[W:c:swg:Combat|combat]] [[W:c:swg:Attribute|attributes]].<ref name="Empire Day" /> Once consumed, the item would disappear from the player's [[W:c:swg:Inventory|inventory]], and the provided attributes would only last for a temporary amount of time. The other version of Gracious Government Mix, costing 5 Empire Day tokens, was permanent, but non-consumable. This latter version acted as a [[W:c:swg:Housing|house]] [[W:c:swg:Decorative art|decoration]]. When examined, the item read, "Spoil yourself like you were royalty with this mix of delicious chocolate said to be the favorites of the Emperor himself."<ref name="AED" /> Oddly, despite its pro-Imperial nature, some versions of ''Star Wars Galaxies'' had the non-edible versions being sold for five Remembrance Day tokens during Remembrance Day festivities.
